problem_type: start_model_setup emitted an unhandled renderer operation
symptom: A real Agent request to open video-model setup returned unknown capability operation settings.open-model-provider.
direct_cause: The desktop lane requested settings.open-model-provider, while the renderer capability handler only implemented integration.open-credentials.
class_root: Renderer bridge operations were hand-copied across the lane and renderer without a shared operation owner or boundary test.
affected_population: users without a ready generation provider
internal_only_reason: The operation is an internal Electron renderer bridge contract.
invariants: start_model_setup opens the existing models settings route without accepting or storing credentials.
The renderer accepts the operation emitted by the desktop lane.
An unavailable setup surface never claims that a provider was connected.
generality_proof: All model setup requests converge through the desktop lane and the renderer capability apply handler.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: The desktop-lane implementation is covered by the lane desktop tools test harness and emits the single operation consumed by the renderer boundary.
The capabilityApplyHandler integration test asserts both bridge paths dispatch the models settings event without storing credentials.

recurrence.reason: Any new renderer bridge operation can drift unless both ends are tested.

prevention.invariant: Model setup bridge operations resolve to the existing settings event.
prevention.failure_mode: Unknown operations fail closed and are surfaced to the Agent.
prevention.strategy: Handle the lane operation at the existing host-surface boundary and cover both operation spellings in one integration test.

legacy_paths.rationale: The existing integration.open-credentials operation remains supported.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No dependency controls the bridge operation.

migration: No persisted data stores the operation name; both bridge spellings remain readable during this fix.
residual_risks: The live provider still requires credentials before generation can execute.
